# Manage a conflict of interest

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When an employee, director, founder or adviser has a personal interest in a company decision. A confidential disclosure and management plan with an independent decision and review owner.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Record the interest and affected decisions

agent-runnable


Collect the relationship, economic interest, transaction and relevant roles in a restricted file. Separate factual disclosures from allegations and identify decisions that should pause pending review.

- Sources: [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Determine the applicable governance process

human · human approval required


Ask counsel or the designated independent reviewer to check the policy, governing documents and local requirements. Select reviewers who are not deciding their own conflict.

- Sources: [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare alternatives and mitigation options

agent-runnable


Document options such as recusal, independent pricing, information barriers or declining the transaction. Identify who can implement each measure and what evidence would show it is working.

- Sources: [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve the conflict-management decision

human · human approval required


The authorized independent decision makers approve or reject the proposal under the applicable process. Record participants, disclosures, recusals and reasons while restricting sensitive personal information.

- Sources: [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Track implementation and subsequent changes

agent-runnable


Confirm access restrictions and other measures with their owners. Calendar a review and reopen the decision when the interest, transaction or responsible role changes.

- Verify: A confidential disclosure and management plan with an independent decision and review owner.
- Sources: [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)
